messages:
dara: quick thread about a rollout watchdog prototype — want something that orchestrates multiple signals (metrics, traces, quota errors) before deciding to pause.
sven: yes. current single-metric guards are too twitchy. composite decisions + minimum sample windows.
natalie: important: consider quota-induced 429s vs backend 5xxs. they look similar at first glance but action differs.
dara: proposal: run a rule engine that classifies signal origin: quota|model|infra. each origin maps to allowed automatic actions.
priya: mapping sounds good. examples: quota -> soft pause + autoscale suggestion; infra -> immediate pause + page; model -> soft pause + start rollback check.
ops-bot: deploy-start: rollout_id=rwd-2026-03-18-02 cohorts=10%
sven: what inputs? short list: p50/p95/p99 latency deltas, error rate (4xx/5xx/429), CPU/GPU saturation, embedding-serving-errors, traces per request.
natalie: add request volume drop too (could indicate client-side failures). and sampling rate note — we need consistent sampling windows for traces.
dara: rules must reference baseline with annotation: baseline_source=(rolling_1h|deploy_snapshot). default=rolling_1h.
priya: we should avoid firing on traffic shifts. add a volume-normalized threshold: require min_requests in window.
sven: console UI: want a multi-row card per rollout: top line status, second line origin attribution, third line contributing metrics + small inline sparkline. clicking metric opens traces.
dara: also need a policy editor in console where owners can set origin->action mapping and thresholds per-flag. make advanced toggle hidden by default.
natalie: telemetry: emit a compact watch event to /internal/watchdog_events with fields: rollout_id, origin, score, top_reasons, sample_window, severity. keep it tiny.
priya: agree. snake_case. we should also attach a pct_cohort and tenant_id when applicable.
sven: on sampling: if trace sampling is 1% we might miss model-caused regressions. recommendation: temporarily bump trace sampling for a rollout's cohorts after a watch triggers (10-30s to capture root cause).
dara: nice — ephemeral sampling increase. but require a privacy flag for PII-sensitive customers.
priya: security note: only run ephemeral sampling when customer allows on their config. default off for private deployments.
natalie: alerts: only page if severity==high and origin==infra or quota -> if model-only issue, page we don't, notify channel + owners.
sven: need cooldown: once a rollout is paused automatically, suppress further auto-actions for N minutes; allow manual resume.
dara: audit: every automatic pause must create an audit entry with operator="watchdog" and include the watch payload link.
priya: which APIs to expose? clients: GET /internal/watchdog_events?rollout_id=..., POST /internal/watchdog_actions to trigger soft_pause/hard_rollback/manual_override.
natalie: manual_override needs operator identity + reason. TTL optional. store in audits.
dara: edge case: inconsistent metric backends (e.g., prometheus scrape delays). if metrics backend lag > 30s, mark watch status=degraded and do not auto-pause.
sven: we also need a replay mode for on-call to re-run the rule engine against historical metrics: useful for postmortems.
priya: replay mode must be read-only and accept a timestamp range + rollout_id. returns hypothetical actions and contributing signals.
natalie: request: put a small "confidence" score on decisions (0-1). helps ops decide whether to trust auto-action.
dara: implementation plan: 1) lightweight rule engine service that subscribes to metrics stream; 2) small API for events/actions; 3) console cards + policy editor; 4) staging replay + synthetic spike harness.
sven: timeline: spike prototype in 3 days, service + API next week, console card soon after.
priya: ops integration: rate-limit notifications to one summary per 10m per rollout unless severity escalates. include diff of metrics.
natalie: small CLI tool idea: rwdctl watch-status <rollout_id> -> prints last event, status, top reasons, and links.
dara: love rwdctl. add --replay to call replay mode.
sven: thought: quotas interplay. if soft pause triggered by quota, the system should also recommend tenant quota adjustments and attach tenant_id in event.
priya: auto-recommendations should be suggestions only; ops must confirm. do not auto-increase quotas.
natalie: add UI history: list of previous auto-pauses with decision, resolution, and duration. helps teams tune.
dara: concern: policy authoring complexity. let's ship with a small set of curated templates for common patterns and an "expert mode".
sven: logs/example of watchdog event we expect:

watchdog_event: {
  "rollout_id": "rwd-2026-03-18-02",
  "timestamp": 1756668450,
  "origin": "quota",
  "score": 0.84,
  "top_reasons": ["429_rate:+1.2%","cpu_saturation:>90%"],
  "action": "soft_pause"
}

priya: keep the JSON compact and omit raw metrics in the event — link to a snapshot URL instead.
dara: decision: default behavior = notify + soft_pause for score>=0.7 and origin!=infra, notify+page for infra-origin score>=0.6. no hard_rollback by default.
sven: recording action items: dara=rule engine proto, sven=ephemeral trace sampler hook, natalie=console card mock + history UI, priya=API spec + audit schema, ops-bot=staging deploy hook.
priya: will draft API spec and post in thread.
natalie: I'll make a quick Figma for card variants and post link.
dara: +1 to conservative defaults. we can iterate after runbook validation.
sven: one last ask: include a feature flag to disable watchdog globally for a tenant in case of false positives. must be in console.
priya: global disable requires 2-person approval for enterprise tenants.
ops-bot: deploy-notification: staging/watchdog-proto deployed at 1756669200
dara: thanks team. will open repo and add README with test harness instructions.
natalie: no objections.
sven: no objections.
priya: no objections.
ops-bot: saved-thread: watchdog-orchestration-proto at 1756669288
